value.question: Can I join more than one clinical trial at the same time?
plan: Check trial protocols for participation limits.
value.draft: Participation in multiple clinical trials depends on the specific protocols of each trial, as some may limit enrollment to one participant per person. It's important to consult with your healthcare provider to ensure that participating in multiple trials is safe for your health. Additionally, review the eligibility criteria for each trial to confirm whether you meet the requirements and if there are any restrictions on concurrent participation. Always seek guidance from the trial coordinators before enrolling in more than one study.
